<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Liquidity and Yields:</strong> The RBI&#x27;s ongoing intervention to defend the rupee is tightening domestic liquidity and driving up bond yields, creating a challenging environment for debt markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Impact:</strong> Shares of major stock exchanges and financial platforms have risen by up to 3% following SEBI’s revision of the Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) framework.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FPI Outflows:</strong> Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) selling has surpassed ₹50,000 crore in October, exerting downward pressure on market sentiment despite mixed global signals.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency Outlook:</strong> The Indian rupee is positioned for a 2% weekly gain as offshore traders reduce bearish bets and the RBI clarifies hedging regulations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPcWRVRDJ2Z3RndjNqQU1JWlRrR2RJN3FMWGZNcFlHOVE1eTE3cV82S1BXX1cxUVhFV3ZKaWxWd2UxUGwxekhtQzlCc3ZqLW54c3lCUDRxS2pxLWNIeDJPUHJWbmJ6VXlVRGF6NFlRZHlCelF1bnZ4dVFZREdnSFlvdzhaXzJvbjNoUWlpWEU0RmlmUGsxbEdnaE8yeG5vZkcyNUVTUVdXcGNrWi1nZlVXY1ZyMG5qNVFBWng2UUcwaDhlZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Trade Relations:</strong> Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has identified China&#x27;s trade barriers as a primary obstacle to bilateral economic ties, highlighting a significant $100 billion deficit.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
